source.citation: KanjiVG, kanji/03092.svg, hiragana を (U+3092 HIRAGANA LETTER WO), three stroke paths kvg:03092-s1 to s3 (Ulrich Apel and contributors, CC BY-SA 3.0)
source.variation: KanjiVG stores each stroke as one directed path in writing order: s1 is the short bar drawn left to right; s2 starts above the bar, descends left through it, turns back sharply without lifting and runs up and right into the arch and down its short stem; s3 starts at the right, sweeps down and left across the middle and rounds the lower left into the rightward base. Only the order and direction are taken from that file. The learner path's coordinates are the bundled Noto Sans JP outline's own medial line, so the print glyph's proportions, not KanjiVG's handwriting-style ones, decide where each stroke runs.
